what_happened: An the person running Athena edited BRIEF.md to add the owner's direction but did not add matching entries to docs/spec.toml. The spec coverage tests then failed for every job, and a study job was rejected because of it. The the person running Athena fixed it by adding requirements with mechanism "none" and confirming the xtask tests pass. The the person running Athena had not run the repo's checks after editing the brief.
cause: Files that must change together (the brief and the spec that traces it) are linked only by a test that runs later. Nothing runs that test, or reminds the editor of the paired file, when the governing file is edited by hand outside a job. Hand edits therefore reach the main branch unchecked, and the break is found only when other jobs fail.
prevention: Add a check that runs automatically on any direct commit that touches BRIEF.md or other governing files, such as a pre-commit or pre-push hook, or a required CI check before it reaches main. The check should run the spec coverage tests (the xtask tests) and refuse the commit when BRIEF.md has requirements with no matching docs/spec.toml entry. The refusal message should name the missing requirement. The check would also cover other hand commits to governed files.
proposed_request: Add an automatic check that runs the spec coverage tests (xtask) whenever a commit changes BRIEF.md or docs/spec.toml, including direct the person running Athena commits outside a job. Run it as a local pre-push hook installed by setup and as a required CI check on the main branch. It should refuse the change and name each BRIEF.md requirement that has no entry in docs/spec.toml. Acceptance: (1) a test commit that adds a requirement to BRIEF.md without a spec.toml entry is refused with the missing requirement named; (2) the same commit with a spec.toml entry (mechanism none allowed) passes; (3) a commit that touches neither file does not run the check.
